lines.en: label halloweennodoka1:
scene otohanodokaphone1
On the other end of the room, which was more accurately the center of the room, which was more accurately the center of the world right now, something was happening.
lines.zh: 在房间的另一端——更确切地说是房间的正中央，更确切地说是此时此刻世界的正中央——有什么事正在发生。

lines.en: A girl who had spent most of the day alone after dropping pipe bombs all over every bridge she could find was calling a girl she was genuinely worried about.
lines.zh: 一个女孩在把她能找到的每一座桥都用管子炸弹炸了个遍之后独自度过了大半天，此刻正在给另一个她真心牵挂的女孩打电话。

lines.en: Knowing that Nodoka Nagasawa had more than just a few screws loose, Otoha Okakura was presently afraid that her head might have fallen off of her shoulders and been picked up by a horny straggler somewhere.
lines.zh: Otoha Okakura 知道 Nodoka Nagasawa 脑袋里松掉的螺丝可不止一两根，此刻她很怕她的头已经从肩膀上滚了下来，被某个发情的流浪汉捡走了。

lines.en: And while the two of them had made promises in the past to never bother one another, Otoha had a built track record of intentionally breaking promises, so that didn’t really matter to her right now.
lines.zh: 虽然她们俩过去约定过永远不打扰对方，但 Otoha 有一长串故意毁约的前科，所以现在那根本不算什么。

lines.en: All that {i}really{/i} mattered was checking on her friend and making sure she wasn’t about to jump off of a roof.
lines.zh: {i}真正{/i}要紧的只有一件事：确认朋友的安危，确保她没打算从屋顶上跳下去。

lines.en: scene otohanodokaphone2
And she wasn’t!
lines.zh: 而她没有！

lines.en: But that guess wasn’t too far off.
lines.zh: 不过那个猜测也差不了太远。

lines.en: : It’s here, it’s here, it must be here. That’s what the letter said. Which polyrhythmic arbiter paints pickled plums in red?
lines.zh: : 就在这儿，就在这儿，一定在这儿。信上就是这么写的。究竟是哪位多节拍的仲裁者把腌梅子涂成了红色？

lines.en: Nodoka Nagasawa hated poetry just like she hated the sound of chalk on a chalkboard. She reveled in the nails instead — that familiar screech that brought her back to now sepia-tinted days full of spoons.
lines.zh: Nodoka Nagasawa 讨厌诗歌，就像她讨厌粉笔划过黑板的声音一样。她反而沉醉于指甲——那种熟悉的刺耳刮擦声，把她带回如今泛着褐色调、满是勺子的那些日子。

lines.en: She was currently (but not blissfully) unaware that someone was trying to get in contact with her. Just like she had been unaware on her walk to the highest place in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 她此刻（但并不幸福地）没有察觉到有人正试图联系她。就像她走向 Kumon-mi 最高处的那一路，也同样毫无觉察一样。

lines.en: If this even {i}was{/i} the highest. If anyone even {i}was{/i} trying to contact her. If this even {i}was{/i} Nodoka Nagasawa and not a different girl wearing her clothes.
lines.zh: 如果这里{i}真的{/i}是最高的地方的话。如果真的{i}有{/i}人在试图联系她的话。如果这{i}真的{/i}是 Nodoka Nagasawa，而不是另一个穿着她衣服的女孩的话。

lines.en: With each step, she comes closer to an inconvenient truth — one that she was not built to house as there were houses built for {i}her.{/i}
lines.zh: 每走一步，她就离一个不便的真相更近一步——她并不是为了「容纳」它而生的，尽管有些房子确实是为{i}她{/i}而建的。

lines.en: No. That wasn’t right. They weren’t for her. But they could be {i}shared{/i} with her under the right pretext.
lines.zh: 不。不是这样的。那些房子不是为她建的。但在合适的借口下，它们可以被{i}分享{/i}给她。

lines.en: Somehow, {i}some{/i} way, she would set foot inside this metaphor dressed as a simile — personifying its intangibility through unconventional means like dream sequences and unintelligible anecdotes.
lines.zh: 无论如何，用{i}某种{/i}方式，她总归会踏进这个伪装成明喻的隐喻里——通过梦境段落和不知所云的轶事这类非常规手段，把它的不可捉摸人格化。

lines.en: But before that, she had things she needed to learn. She had truths she needed to pluck from the dirt before acting as a mother bird to a mother-bird.
lines.zh: 但在那之前，她还有必须学会的东西。在充当一只鸟妈妈去照顾另一只鸟妈妈之前，她得先把那些真相从泥土里拔出来。

lines.en: Yet she’d rather {i}smother{/i} birds because {i}other{/i} words pushed her so far in the opposite direction of her predecessor that she’d sidelined one story and wound up in another.
lines.zh: 可她宁愿把鸟儿{i}闷死{/i}，因为{i}别的{/i}说法把她推得离她的前辈太远，远到她撇下了一个故事，却落进了另一个故事里。

lines.en: As the light of last summer shone down on an upside down house, she questioned whether her feet kissed the floor or the ceiling. That’s the funny thing about roofs, you see.
lines.zh: 当去年夏日的阳光洒在一栋倒置的房子上，她开始怀疑自己的脚亲吻的究竟是地板还是天花板。瞧，屋顶的有趣之处就在这里。

lines.en: They’re two things at the same time, serving different purposes for different people.
lines.zh: 它们同时是两种东西，对不同的人起着不同的作用。

lines.en: That’s what Nodoka Nagasawa was here to do as well. It wasn’t enough to just choose one anymore. She cared too much now. If she didn’t, she wouldn’t be here. Right?
lines.zh: 这也是 Nodoka Nagasawa 来这里要做的事。光是选一个已经不够了。她现在在乎的太多了。如果她不在乎，她就不会在这儿了。对吧？

lines.en: No one person can be {i}that{/i} curious, don’t you think? That makes {i}me{/i} curious, though.
lines.zh: 没有人能{i}那么{/i}好奇吧，你说呢？不过这倒是让{i}我{/i}好奇起来了。

lines.en: I wonder what face she’ll make when she realizes her fountain pen has run out of ink.
lines.zh: 我好奇她发现自己钢笔没水时会是什么表情。

lines.en: Perhaps there is more in a well somewhere.
lines.zh: 也许某处的井里还有更多。

lines.en: scene otohanodokaphone1
To Otoha again.
lines.zh: 画面回到 Otoha。

lines.en: scene otohanodokaphone3
: What?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！

lines.en: To {i}both{/i} of them this time — two sides of one coin, just one of them was blank and the other was rusted.
lines.zh: 这次是{i}她们两个{/i}——一枚硬币的两面，只是一面是空白的，另一面生了锈。

lines.en: : I’m doing great. And you?
lines.zh: : 我好得很。你呢？

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how much of a thorn in my paw you’ve been today?! I’d be better off letting you infect me and amputating myself at this point!
lines.zh: : 你知不知道你今天在我的爪子里扎了多大的一根刺？！到这个地步，我还不如让你感染我，然后把自己截肢算了！

lines.en: : Yeah, I love you too. I’m really happy to hear you finally admit it.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我也爱你。真高兴听到你终于承认了。

lines.en: : What the fuck do you want?! I’m busy trying to save your fucking life!
lines.zh: : 你他妈到底想干什么？！我正忙着救你那条操蛋的命！

lines.en: : That’s gonna be hard to do with you...wherever the fuck you are right now as you’re most definitely not with me.
lines.zh: : 那可难办了，毕竟你他妈人在……鬼知道哪里，反正肯定不在我身边。

lines.en: : I’m at school! I’m learning! That’s what people do here, motherfucker! Now either come here and help or delete my number!
lines.zh: : 我在学校！我在学习！这儿的人就是干这个的，混蛋！你要么过来帮忙，要么把我的号码删了！

lines.en: scene otohanodokaphone4
: What do you mean you’re “at school?” School ended hours ago. I thought you were in your room?
lines.zh: : 你说你「在学校」是什么意思？学校几个小时前就放学了。我还以为你在房间里？

lines.en: : Yes! And then I figured something out because my worthless but extremely hot roommate stopped pestering me for the sole purpose of making it seem like she isn’t feeling utterly alone!
lines.zh: : 是啊！然后我想明白了一件事——因为我那个一无是处但极其火辣的室友不再烦我了，而她这么做唯一的目的，就是让自己看起来不是彻底孤身一人！

lines.en: : Damn, yo. You’re just gonna call me out like that?
lines.zh: : 靠，喂。你就这么当面拆穿我？

lines.en: scene otohanodokaphone5
: That’s right. Now go lure some other unsuspecting lesbian into a relationship and leave me out of it. At least emotionally. I can fuck you when I get home tonight. Just keep your mouth shut.
lines.zh: : 没错。现在去勾引别的毫无防备的女同谈恋爱吧，别把我扯进去。至少感情上别。我今晚回家可以跟你上床。只要你闭嘴就行。

lines.en: : Why are you really at school, Nodoka? What are you planning on doing there? Because every time you wander off in the middle of these episodes-
lines.zh: : 你到底为什么在学校，Nodoka？你打算在那儿干什么？因为每次你在这种发作中途跑掉——

lines.en: scene otohanodokaphone6
: They aren’t “episodes!” They’re moments of heightened brilliance! I’m transcending! I can see everything, damn it! Don’t call me insane just because everyone else is blind!
lines.zh: : 那不是「发作」！那是极度辉煌的瞬间！我在超脱！我什么都能看见，该死的！别因为别人都是瞎子就说我是疯子！

lines.en: : Well then...what do you see this time?
lines.zh: : 那好吧……这次你看见了什么？

lines.en: scene otohanodokaphone5
: Nothing yet because you can’t listen to fucking directions. I think...something is going to happen, though.
lines.zh: : 还没看见什么，因为你根本他妈的不听指示。不过我觉得……有什么事要发生了。

lines.en: : Something as in...{i}what{/i} exactly?
lines.zh: : 有事要发生，具体是{i}什么{/i}事？

lines.en: scene otohanodokaphone7
: I’m still working on that part. All I know is I told myself to come here, I’m just not sure {i}when.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那部分我还在想。我只知道是我告诉自己来这儿的，我只是不确定是{i}什么时候{/i}。

lines.en: : Does alternate timeline Nodoka not believe in dating her notes or something?
lines.zh: : 平行时间线里的 Nodoka 是不相信给笔记署日期吗，还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Give me a fucking break. If this was as simple as reading my own notes I wouldn’t be five minutes away from throwing myself off of the fucking roof.
lines.zh: : 你他妈饶了我吧。要是这事只要读读我自己的笔记就行，我也不会离从这操蛋的屋顶上跳下去只剩五分钟了。

lines.en: : There’s a code. One that I’ve figured out because I’m a fucking genius. And also probably because it was me who made it. But even finding where I hid them is-
lines.zh: : 有一套密码。我把它解出来了，因为我是个他妈的天才。大概也因为那套密码本来就是我编的。但光是找到我把它们藏在哪儿都——

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. {i}Outside{/i} the barrier, right?
lines.zh: : 行行行。在结界{i}外面{/i}，对吧？

lines.en: scene otohanodokaphone8
: Do not {i}mock{/i} me, whore! Just because I can reach places you can’t even comprehend does not mean those places do not {i}exist!{/i}
lines.zh: : 别{i}嘲笑{/i}我，婊子！我能到达你根本无法理解的地方，不代表那些地方不{i}存在{/i}！

lines.en: : And also, please allow me to add that I {i}do{/i} date my notes, BUT THAT DOESN’T FUCKING MATTER WHEN THE DATE IS THE SAME AS TODAY!
lines.zh: : 另外，请允许我补充一句：我{i}确实{/i}会给笔记署日期，但日期跟今天是一样的，那他妈有什么用！

lines.en: scene otohanodokaphone9
: Listen, Nodoka...I’m glad that you’re not getting those headaches anymore, but if you’re going to keep putting yourself in danger like this, maybe you should...you know...{i}see someone.{/i}
lines.zh: : 听着，Nodoka……我很高兴你不再头疼了，但如果你还要这样不停把自己置于险境，也许你该……你知道的……去{i}看看医生{/i}。

lines.en: : I’m already {i}seeing{/i} Akira. And I’m pretty sure his precum contains some sort of divine aphrodisiac as he gets me even wetter than you’d be during recess at an elementary school for boys.
lines.zh: : 我已经在{i}见{/i} Akira 了。而且我敢肯定他的前列腺液里含有某种神圣的催情剂，因为他让我湿得比男小学生在课间休息时还要湿。

lines.en: : I meant a {i}doctor,{/i} idiot. Because I’m all about letting you “do your thing,” but not if it means hearing you’re five minutes away from “throwing yourself off the fucking roof.”
lines.zh: : 我说的{i}医生{/i}，白痴。我是百分百支持你「做你的事」的，但不包括听你说你离「从那操蛋的屋顶上跳下去」只剩五分钟。

lines.en: : Like, you’d come after me if I started writing music while tightrope walking, wouldn’t you?
lines.zh: : 就好比，如果我开始在走钢丝的时候写歌，你也会来追我的，对吧？

lines.en: : No. That would be fucking awesome. And even if it wasn’t, you can die for all I care. Maybe then I’d be able to get some peace and fucking quiet.
lines.zh: : 不会。那他妈酷毙了。而且就算不酷，你死了我也不在乎。说不定那样我才能得来一点平静和清净。

lines.en: : You don’t mean that, Nodoka. Just...go home, okay? You need some sleep. You’ll think better in the morning.
lines.zh: : 你不是真心的，Nodoka。就……回家吧，好吗？你需要睡一觉。明早你会想得更清楚。

lines.en: scene otohanodokaphone10

: I don’t {i}have{/i} until the morning! When I said that something is going to happen, I meant something is going to happen {i}tonight!{/i} Something I need to get to the bottom of before I fucking {i}forget!{/i}
lines.zh: : 我{i}等不到{/i}早上！我说有事要发生，意思是事情{i}今晚{/i}就要发生！是我必须在我他妈{i}忘掉{/i}之前查清楚的事！

lines.en: : Nodoka...
lines.zh: : Nodoka……

lines.en: : Don’t “Nodoka” me you angel-voiced idol fucker! You haven’t the {i}faintest{/i} idea how many of times I’ve done this and failed! And neither do I! That’s the whole fucking point!
lines.zh: : 别用那种语气叫我的名字，你这天使嗓音的偶像混蛋！你{i}根本{/i}不知道我这样做过多少次、又失败了多少次！我也不知道！这才是他妈的重点！

lines.en: : Then why keep trying?! It’s driving you insane! And no one has any idea what you’re trying to do in the first place!
lines.zh: : 那你为什么还要继续？！这会把你逼疯的！而且根本没人知道你到底想干什么！

lines.en: : Neither do I! That’s why I haven’t succeeded yet!
lines.zh: : 我自己也不知道！所以我才一直没成功！

lines.en: : Okay, correction — it’s not {i}driving{/i} you insane. You {i}are{/i} insane. And now, you’re making things even worse for yourself by sneaking off to school in the middle of the night presumably naked.
lines.zh: : 好吧，更正一下——不是这事儿在{i}逼{/i}疯你。你{i}本来就是{/i}疯子。而现在你还半夜三更偷偷溜去学校，大概还是光着身子，把自己搞得更糟。

lines.en: : I’m not naked this time! I didn’t want to risk getting sexually assaulted by someone who doesn’t excrete an aphrodisiac from their genitals! I don’t have time for that! Or...maybe I do?!
lines.zh: : 这次我没光着！我可不想冒被某个不会从生殖器里分泌催情剂的人性侵的风险！我没那个时间！或者……也许我有时间？！

lines.en: scene otohanodokaphone11
: I have no fucking idea anymore! What even {i}is{/i} time?! Because it’s entirely possible we’ve fucking had this conversation already and we’ve just been forced to forget it!
lines.zh: : 我他妈已经完全不知道了！时间{i}到底是个什么玩意儿{/i}？！因为完全有可能我们他妈早就说过这段对话了，只是被迫忘了而已！

lines.en: : Nodoka!
lines.zh: : Nodoka！

lines.en: scene otohanodokaphone12
: Maggots.
: ...What?!
: Shiori was dead for {i}a full week{/i} before they found her. And by the time they did, maggots had already eaten their way into her stomach. Can you ignore {i}that,{/i} Otoha?
lines.zh: : Shiori 死了{i}整整一周{/i}才被人发现。而等到发现的时候，蛆已经一路啃进了她的胃里。你能对{i}这个{/i}视而不见吗，Otoha？

lines.en: : I have no fucking clue what you’re talking about right now.
lines.zh: : 我他妈完全不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : Because {i}you{/i} have never smelt the dead! She was loved! There’s no way they didn’t know! Something- {i}someone{/i} rewrote them! The same thing is probably happening to us!
lines.zh: : 因为{i}你{/i}从来没闻过死人的味道！她是被人爱着的！他们不可能不知道！有什么东西——{i}有什么人{/i}改写了他们！同样的事大概也正发生在我们身上！

lines.en: : Nodoka...maybe it’s time to put your mom in a home. Because I’m starting to think that being around her-
lines.zh: : Nodoka……也许是时候把你妈送进疗养院了。因为我开始觉得，跟她待在一起——

lines.en: : A home for who?...
lines.zh: : 给谁住的疗养院？……

lines.en: : Those who are misunderstood?...
lines.zh: : 给那些被误解的人？……

lines.en: : Those who are only {i}called{/i} insane because no one believes them?! What they’ve been through?!
lines.zh: : 给那些只是因为没人相信他们、没人相信他们的遭遇，就被{i}叫作{/i}疯子的人？！

lines.en: : Do {i}I{/i} need to be put into a “home” as well then, Otoha?!
lines.zh: : 那{i}我{/i}是不是也该被送进「疗养院」，Otoha？！

lines.en: scene otohanodokaphone13
: Do {i}I{/i} need to suffer because no one else can keep up?! You are supposed to be on my side! You’re supposed to see the world through my eyes! That’s why I share them with you!
lines.zh: : 就因为别人跟不上，{i}我{/i}就该受苦吗？！你本该是站在我这边的！你本该透过我的眼睛看这个世界！所以我才把它们分给你！

lines.en: : But now you just want to spit on them and roll them through the mud and fucking shit on them, Otoha?! You’re shitting on my eyes! You’re going to make me blind!
lines.zh: : 可现在你只想往上面吐口水、拖着它们在泥里打滚、再他妈拉屎在上面，Otoha？！你在往我的眼睛上拉屎！你会把我弄瞎的！

lines.en: : Nodoka-
lines.zh: : Nodoka——

lines.en: : No! I’m tired of it! I’m tired of being the only person with a chance to break the mold! I wish nothing more than for the rest of you to be geniuses too! But I guess I’m just {i}fucked,{/i} huh?!
lines.zh: : 不！我受够了！我受够了只有我一个人有机会打破这个模子！我最大的心愿就是你们其他人也都是天才！但看来我就是{i}倒霉透顶{/i}了，是吧？！

lines.en: : Nodoka!
lines.zh: : Nodoka！

lines.en: : I guess this burden is {i}mine{/i} to bear just like hers! I guess I have to fix two worlds instead of one! And I guess if I {i}don’t{/i} I’m just gonna fuck my teacher forever! {i}Forever!{/i} That’s so much fucking!
lines.zh: : 看来这份重担跟她的一样，是{i}我{/i}该扛的！看来我得修好两个世界而不是一个！而且看来如果{i}不{/i}修好，我就只能永远跟我老师做爱！{i}永远！{/i}那得做多少次啊！

lines.en: : Nodoka! Listen to me!
lines.zh: : Nodoka！听我说！

lines.en: : Don’t get me wrong — he makes me cum harder than any toy and smut combination ever could! But {i}forever?!{/i} I will {i}obviously{/i} get bored! That’s probably why I’m trying to contact myself in the first place!
lines.zh: : 别误会——他让我高潮得比任何玩具加色情作品的组合都猛！但{i}永远？！{/i}我{i}显然{/i}会腻的！大概这才是我想联系自己的原因！

lines.en: : Nodoka!
lines.zh: : Nodoka！

lines.en: scene otohanodokaphone14
: {size=+20}WHAT?!?!?!{/size}
lines.zh: {size=+20}什么？！？！？！{/size}

lines.en: scene otohanodokaphone15
: Woah, what the fuck?
lines.zh: : 哇，什么鬼？

lines.en: : What do you mean “what the fuck?” You’re freaking me the hell out. {i}That’s{/i} “what the fuck.”
lines.zh: : 你「什么鬼」是什么意思？你把我吓坏了。{i}这才{/i}叫「什么鬼」。

lines.en: : How...long have you been there exactly?
lines.zh: : 你……到底在那儿待了多久？

lines.en: scene otohanodokaphone16
: I’ve been here the whole fucking time! We came here {i}together!{/i} I literally helped you jump the gate!
lines.zh: : 我他妈从头到尾都在这儿！我们是{i}一起{/i}来的！我还亲手帮你翻的校门！

lines.en: : Wait, really? Then who was I just talking to on the phone just now?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的？那我刚刚在电话里跟谁说话？

lines.en: : No one! Yet you keep on doing it and {i}that{/i} is freaking me the fuck out too!
lines.zh: : 没人！可你一直这么做，{i}那{/i}也把我吓死了！

lines.en: scene otohanodokaphone17
: Listen, I know you brought me here because you have, like...some super genius plan you’re trying to take care of or whatever, but I {i}can’t{/i} let you keep doing this.
lines.zh: : 听着，我知道你带我来是因为你有个……什么超级天才计划要处理之类的，但我{i}不能{/i}再让你这样下去了。

lines.en: : I’ve barely even {i}slept{/i} lately because you keep fucking waking me up in the middle of the night, dude.
lines.zh: : 我最近几乎都没怎么{i}睡{/i}过，因为你老是三更半夜把我叫醒，哥们儿。

lines.en: : And I get that you’re against it and everything, but I {i}really{/i} think you need to see a shrink or something, Nodoka. This shit’s gone way too far.
lines.zh: : 我知道你反对看医生什么的，但我{i}真的{/i}觉得你该去看看心理医生，Nodoka。这事已经太过分了。

lines.en: : You’re losing yourself, man. And if you keep this up, you’re gonna lose {i}me{/i} too.
lines.zh: : 你在失去你自己，老兄。再这样下去，你也会失去{i}我{/i}的。

lines.en: : I know that’s not what you want. I know you think you’re doing this {i}for{/i} me or...{i}us{/i} or...whoever you say you’re doing it for. But this isn’t what we want.
lines.zh: : 我知道那不是你想要的。我知道你觉得你是为了{i}我{/i}……或者{i}我们{/i}……或者你说的随便谁才这么做的。但这不是我们想要的。

lines.en: : Maybe...time {i}is{/i} repeating. Maybe you {i}are{/i} right. But none of {i}us{/i} know that. So isn’t it better if we all just...stay in the dark?
lines.zh: : 也许……时间{i}真的{/i}在重复。也许你{i}真的{/i}是对的。但我们{i}谁{/i}都不知道。那我们大家就这么……蒙在鼓里，不是更好吗？

lines.en: : Well?
lines.zh: : 怎么样？

lines.en: : Holy shit.
lines.zh: : 我操。

lines.en: : I really am fucking insane, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 我真的他妈是个疯子，对吧？

lines.en: scene otohanodokaphone18
: Maybe not if you’re actually willing to admit it now...
lines.zh: : 也许不算——如果你现在真的愿意承认的话……

lines.en: : But either way, can we go home? Because now I’m just tired and {i}confused{/i} and...know what? How about I buy you dinner or some shit on the way back? As...thanks for trying to...{i}save us.{/i}
lines.zh: : 不过不管怎样，我们能回家了吗？因为我现在只是又累又{i}困惑{/i}……而且……这样吧，回去的路上我请你吃顿晚饭什么的，就当……谢谢你试着……{i}救我们{/i}。

lines.en: : Anything you want. Just name it.
lines.zh: : 你想要什么都行。尽管开口。

lines.en: : I want a whole fucking rotisserie chicken.
lines.zh: : 我要一整只他妈的烤鸡。

lines.en: : ...Really?
: {i}That’s{/i} what-
lines.zh: : {i}你就要{/i}这个——

lines.en: : And lemonade.
lines.zh: : 还有柠檬水。

lines.en: : {i}Two{/i} lemonades.
lines.zh: : {i}两杯{/i}柠檬水。

lines.en: : And JagaRico.
lines.zh: : 还有 JagaRico。

lines.en: scene black
: Sure, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 好，Nodoka。

lines.en: : You can have an entire rotisserie chicken, two lemonades, and some JagaRico.
lines.zh: : 你可以吃到一整只烤鸡、两杯柠檬水，还有 JagaRico。

lines.en: scene otohanodokaphone19

: You know, maybe we should look into getting you micro-chipped or something? Because if you ran off on your own tonight and I {i}wasn’t{/i} here to talk you down, who knows what could have went wrong?
lines.zh: : 说真的，也许我们该考虑给你植入个芯片什么的？因为要是今晚你自己跑了，而我{i}又不在{/i}这儿劝住你，谁知道会出什么事？

lines.en: : I’d probably be naked. Or mostly naked. I like being naked when I hear things. And the rest of the time. I wish we were all naked, all the time. That’s the world I really want.
lines.zh: : 我大概会光着身子。或者基本光着。我听见东西的时候喜欢光着。其他时候也喜欢。我希望我们所有人都永远光着身子。那才是我真正想要的世界。

lines.en: : Well, do you want to know what world {i}I{/i} really want? One where my roommate isn’t a fucking lunatic and doesn’t force me to skip out on parties just to watch her talk to herself on a roof.
lines.zh: : 那你想知道{i}我{/i}真正想要的世界是什么样吗？一个我的室友不是他妈的疯子、不会逼我翘掉派对、就为了看她在屋顶上自言自语的世界。

lines.en: : I’m...sorry, Otoha. This is...kind of weird for me.
lines.zh: : 我……抱歉，Otoha。这对我来说……有点奇怪。

lines.en: : I’ve never really contemplated the fact that I’ve been actually {i}seeing{/i} things before. This is a huge fucking curveball, huh? Why didn’t past me say anything?
lines.zh: : 我还从来没有认真想过自己其实一直在{i}看见{/i}东西这件事。这真是个操蛋的变化球，是吧？为什么过去的我什么都没说？

lines.en: : Because “past you” probably doesn’t even exist. This could all be one huge fucking hallucination that-
lines.zh: : 因为「过去的你」大概根本不存在。这一切可能只是一大场他妈的幻觉——

lines.en: : Ahem.
scene otohanodokaphone20
: That...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: scene otohanodokaphone21
scene otohanodokaphone22
: Ah, crap.
lines.zh: : 啊，糟了。

lines.en: : You’re...the one she...
lines.zh: : 你就是……她说的那个人……

lines.en: scene otohanodokaphone23
: I’m sorry, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 对不起，Nodoka。

lines.en: : I tried.
lines.zh: : 我试过了。
